note: Buchanan County Conservation Board campground in Jakway Forest, 2 miles south of Aurora, on the developed east side of Buffalo Creek. Shaded oak campground on an oval drive-in loop; the concrete shower house doubles as a storm shelter. Disc golf, playground, shelter house, fishing in the creek and the old quarry pond, wildlife blind, and the historic Richardson-Jakway House (tours by appointment). Hunting is allowed west of the creek, not on the developed side. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 electric / $15 non-electric, FCFS (only Fontana reserves), showers, dump; added flush toilets, drinking water, season Apr 15-Oct 1 (campsite page says mid-Oct). Not waterfront stands: the loop is 110-150 m from narrow Buffalo Creek through forest.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront stands. Esri imagery shows the oval campground loop at the pin, in open oak woods; Buffalo Creek (~7-10 m wide, creek width) runs 110-150 m west of the loop's west edge through continuous forest, and the quarry pond is ~200 m NW. No view of either from the loop.
SEASON: two county pages differ on the close (October 1 on the park page, 'mid-October' on the campsite page); recorded Apr 15-Oct 1 with both in season.note.
HOOKUPS: electric 30 (derived from old note prose) is not stated by any county page; left as is. No site count is posted anywhere.
FEES: the $15 non-electric sites are on the same loop as far as the pages say; if they take a motorhome the base could be $15 rather than $20. Stored $20 kept.
PIN OK (~40 m from the loop centre). Phone 319-636-2617 confirmed (county camping page). The county's 2019 'Campground info' PDF still linked from its camping page shows old fees ($18/$12).
